At its core, MultiColor is a reaction-based game where you control a series of colorful objects that are falling from the top of the screen. Your goal is to click on the next object in the sequence, which adds a new layer of complexity as the game progresses.

The game's core premise is simple yet deceptively challenging. The objects are falling in a predetermined sequence, and your job is to click on the next object in the sequence before it hits the object below it. Sounds easy, right? Despite its simplicity, MultiColor is a game that will keep you on the edge of your seat as you try to beat your high score.

The game's sound effects are also well-done, with a satisfying 'click' sound that accompanies each successful click.

MultiColor is a game that is perfect for players who enjoy a good challenge. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or a casual player, this game is sure to provide hours of entertainment and fun. With its simple yet addictive gameplay, unique visual style, and engaging atmosphere, MultiColor is a game that is not to be missed.
